Request a Consultation Memberships Financing Gift Cards Skincare Products Request a Consultation Request a Consultation Back Laurie Rodden, LE Master Esthetician Locations: Dover Laurie became a licensed Medical Esthetician in 2008 and has been working at Skin Health Medi Spa since 2010. She prides herself on her ability to help her clients take care of their skin and feel beautiful, and loves sharing the most effective and innovative techniques with them. Laurie is trained in advanced medical modalities like Exilis, Cutera IPL, and Microneedling. She is also highly skilled at doing facials, peels, makeup applications, and lash extensions. Laurie is a dedicated mother of two beautiful children and enjoys gardening, cooking, decorating, and spending time at the lake with family and friends. Laurie is detail-oriented, a perfectionist, and an empathetic listener, making her an incredible asset to Skin Health and the many happy clients that she serves.
